purpose: SIM_ONLY test whether authenticated 30-frame precontact snapshots can reproduce frozen-parent physical collision before any RL training
diagnostic_teacher: recorded future SONIC joint targets; privileged hindsight used only for parent replay equivalence, not a policy input
acceptance: All 16 snapshots have precontact ball position maximum error <=0.005 m and root position <=0.01 m; first contact offset differs by <=1 control frame and first-contact body class is identical. Otherwise reject short-horizon training surrogate.
